description: This Java class is a command handler for processing recurring deposit account applications within the Fineract project. It handles the 'CREATE' action for the entity 'RECURRINGDEPOSITACCOUNT' by delegating the application submission to a service layer.

classes.name: RecurringDepositAccountApplicationSubmittalCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class implementing command handling for creating recurring deposit account applications, delegating the process to a service layer.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes a command to create a recurring deposit account application by invoking the deposit application service's submitRDApplication method.
